pages.title: Casimir Energy Cell
pages.text: An energy store built around the force between two plates in a vacuum. Between closely spaced conductors, fewer vacuum modes fit, so the outside pushes them together; this cell charges by tensioning that gap. It hums very faintly.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Casimir plates press together with energy taken from nothing. Pairing them with a Chronon Capacitor in a chronosteel shell, I found I could store that tension and release it on demand.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Plasma Metallurgy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Vacuum Energy Cell.
